polishes.name: 505 Roja
polishes.description: Don’t be fooled by the name, Backyard Hootenanny is a bootle filled with a very classy, beautiful, and ethereal linear holo topper aka Spectraflair. No corners are cut here - we bring you the good stuff.We suggest trying a single coat over any of your favorite Uno Mas color polishes to make a unique combination. Use additional coats to get a stronger holographic effect.

polishes.name: Backyard Hootenanny
polishes.description: Can't get enough of our base and top coats? You're in luck! You can now purchase a 2oz refill bottle - that's 4 glass bottle re-ups! Choose from our base and top coats so you never run out of what you need to rock your favorite polish.

polishes.name: Base or Top Coat Refill Bottle
Besties
polishes.description: This polish contains a magnetic holo pigment that is simply too much fun for words. It does a great cat eye and looks fantastic as a velvet so get creative and see what else you can do! When magnetized, this polish reveals a base of silky lavender purple shimmering with blue/green.

polishes.name: Beyond Icarus
polishes.description: Blanca is a stark white creme that is opaque in 2 coats.As with all our cremes, play around and have fun. Layer, add toppers, add jellies, add a few stickers because why not. We suggest you let the creme dry before laying another color or topper to avoid mixing.

polishes.name: Brillante
polishes.description: The warmth of this purple polish is just the beginning of what you’ll experience when you put the first coat. The linear holographic shimmer (Spectraflair) captures the light and brings brilliance and shine with each additional coat. While we suggest at least two coats, we encourage you to play with this polish to find the right level of vibrance for your liking.

polishes.name: Casa De Bebé: La Niña
polishes.description: A shimmery, sparkly blue with a subtle hint of purple that sneaks up on you in the best way. It applies smoothly, reaches full opacity in two coats, and deepens into a richer blue with each additional layer.

polishes.name: Casa De Mí Corazón
polishes.description: Four little hematite magnets lead to infinite opportunities for chaos! 😈 Stack them, angle them, separate them, or arrange them around the nail to experiment with unexpected magnetic effects. There is no single correct configuration which is exactly the point.

polishes.name: Chaos Magnets
polishes.finish: Magnetic, Glow in the Dark, Flakes
polishes.description: A flakie magnetic that also glows. The dark base gives the green/blue magnetic a strong contrast against silver flakies; magnetizing creates extra depth, and when charged the polish glows bright green.

polishes.name: Criatura De La Black Lagoon
polishes.description: This is a delicious black to red thermal that will satisfy the inner Goth you never knew you had! It goes from a black(ish) color when cold to a bold red when warm and of course you get the range of colors between. (We say blackish because the base color isn’t black like the night, more like black like dark cherries. The black looks much blacker the more you layer.)We recommend at least 2 coats to darken the black. This also looks great with a coat of Gothspeed, My Friend over the top to really vamp it up!

polishes.name: Currently Accepting Compliments
polishes.description: This is a thermal that goes from teal to green, with a green shimmer as bright as a snake’s new skin. It goes opaque in 2-3 coats depending on preference.

polishes.name: Danger Noodle
polishes.description: The strong blue tones give way to subtle green and purple shimmers as you layer. This color shift polish leans on the cool side of the palette. For best results, we suggest two even coats to get the deepest hues, and bright shimmers that will last a good period of time.

polishes.name: Featherweight Champion
polishes.description: This is a super shifty polish loaded with holographic and hypershift pigments. It’s a dark brown base with a rich flow of gold, orange, and green chameleon colors embraced by a sparkly fine holo to let you see the stars even when it’s cloudy.

polishes.name: Formula 2: Electric Boogaloo
polishes.description: This thermal goes from orange to light orange based on your body temperature, and in its warm state it shows the “frost” component in the form of sparkly white flakes. A surprising red/orange shimmer threads its way through adding a little shimmer in every movement.The glow of this polish will differ based on the warmth. As you can see in the photos, everyone has had different glow results!

polishes.name: Glitter Smoothie Top Coat
polishes.description: This jelly is truly translucent with 1-3 coats and builds to a rich “bloody” red that will have even the most serious creatures of the night cracking a smile. This red looks different on every person, so experiment and make it your own!

polishes.name: Grip It, Grip It Good Pvb Free Base Coat
polishes.description: This is a cool leaning grey creme that is great on its own or a perfect base for toppers, nail art, stickers, etc. We suggest using 2 coats to get full coverage. Try this in matte for a totally different feel!

polishes.name: Hola Again
polishes.description: This is a warm purple neon loaded with gold chameleon flakes that dance with colors of orange, gold, pink, and purple. Get this on your claws and go out into the world knowing you’re living your best Hot Ghoul Summer in the fall.

polishes.name: Hot Ghoul Summer
polishes.description: This is a vibrant neon pink creme polish with a soft light pink glow. We suggest at least 2 coats to display the potent tones. This is a soft glow in the dark polish and we suggest charging your mani to have the best glow.

polishes.name: I Am the Storm
polishes.description: This polish is a magnetic topper comprised of a scatter holo effect and a magnetic silver component. This can be worn unmagnetized for a silvering effect (the holo should still show in sun) or magnetize it to maximize your holo sparkle!This silver magnetic pigment is just as fast as a silver bullet so you’ll be able to play around with it for a few seconds before it starts to set. We think this looks best in a cat eye or line type design but it also flashes great as a velvet.

polishes.name: I Came in Like a Disco Ball
Just Think How Much More More Would Be
Kelp Me Out Here
polishes.description: This color shift polish goes on smooth with a vibrant shimmer and nice depth. One coat will yield a purple/pink tone and a second coat will bring more blurples and blues! Two to three coats is recommended for maximum mani life.

polishes.name: La Chupacabra on Edibles
polishes.finish: Solar, Glow in the Dark, Shimmer, Jelly
polishes.description: This is a solar reactive, glow in the dark formula that changes from a pale white to a deep pink in UV light including that big ball of light above us. (You can cheat and use a UV light to make it change inside too!) The color switch has infinite shades depending on how sunny it is, how long your nails are exposed, etc. and this is a fast change formula so it goes back to white within 2 minutes of being inside.This solar polish is meant to be translucent, much like La Llorona herself. It has an ethereal orange shimmer that just grows stronger in the sunlight as the base color turns to purple. The glow component of this polish is ridiculously strong: it fully charges with overhead lighting or sunlight, and will last for up to 8 hours.

polishes.name: La Llorona
polishes.description: This is a deep coral jelly with gold flakies that has a gentle pink/coral glow when charged. Its bright notes of coral and gold capture the light to give a brilliant shimmer.

polishes.name: Lado a Lado, Una Vez Mas
polishes.description: Bright pink shades and light blue shimmer are just the start of this amazing magnetic polish. Grab your favorite magnet and get creative! We suggest a cat’s eye effect or any effect that uses lines or swooshes to maximize the magnetic pigment. For best results, we suggest a minimum of two coats to get maximum coverage and color dispersion.

polishes.name: Love Unfeigned
polishes.description: This polish is a custom red creme that's strong with one coat but we suggest two coats for a strong mani to match your energy!

polishes.name: Main Character Energy
polishes.description: This matte topper is smoooooth. Other matte toppers leave your nails feeling like a chalkboard - this stuff gives you nails that feel like that lovely velvety paper: rich and luscious. (BTW, the velvety paper is called vellum!)We suggest 1 coat to finish your manicure. For additional protection, finish your manicure with a standard quick dry top coat and come back after 6-24 hours to add this for a strong and beautiful matte finish.This top coat is also Solar Friendly! That’s right, no UV blockers here so layer it up with your solars for maximum results.

polishes.name: Mr. Myers
polishes.description: This is a pretty standard quick dry top coat but we do have one big differentiator... This one is 21 free. That’s right, there’s no crap or fluff in this bottle, just straight up shiny quick dry top coat.

polishes.name: Muy Rápido Quick Dry Top Coat
polishes.description: This is a standard (well as standard as we can be) black creme. It’s allllmost a one coat black but we suggest using 2 coats for extra coverage.It’s great to wear on its own or as a base to explore your unique ideas with different toppers and colors! It’s also great for nail art both as a base and as a stamping polish (although it’s not a dedicated stamping polish, just a versatile creme).

polishes.name: Noche
polishes.description: This is a sheer topper that adds a subtle blue glow and shimmer to any base color. We recommend two coats for maximum shimmer but the journey is up to you!Número Uno is a great addition when you want to extend the life of your mani - add a coat or two and it’s like a whole new polish. Use on top of cremes to give them a little boost of something special.

polishes.name: Número Uno
polishes.description: This is a magnetic topper and builds best over darker colors. If put on bare nails, we recommend a ridge filler base or tinted base if you don’t want your nail lines to show.

polishes.name: Ocean Sunset
polishes.description: This polish was inspired by the traditional French manicure but just pink is just not enough. A little hint of violet shimmer has us saying “ooh la la” all day long! The pink is very delicate and is opaque in about 3 coats. We find 2.5 is the magic number when using a standard base coat to ensure full coverage.

polishes.name: Ooh La La, Bruh
polishes.description: This magnetic beauty looks deceptively simple but is a perfect marriage of orange, yellow, and gold! It's developed to be worn either magnetized or not, depending on your preference and is opaque in 1 coat.

polishes.name: Relit
polishes.description: This is serious cuticle rescue in a convenient, cute little package. It's designed to work as well as cuticle oil without the mess! This is epecially handy before a mani, between manis, or anytime your cuticles are looking particularly offended by life. (Which for us is pretty much always). Mango and illipe butters join jojoba and meadowfoam oils, plus vitamin E and bisabolol, to condition dry, rough skin around your nails. The solid stick lets you swipe it exactly where you need it, without drips, spills, or greasy fingers digging into a jar.It has a light, warm, woodsy scent with frankincense, hinoki wood, and a touch of orange.

polishes.name: Silk Scarf
polishes.description: This is a sticky base coat that adheres to your nail and the polish to create a strong bond that should reduce chipping. We think this is the grippiest thing we’ve ever used so if you’re looking for a workhorse that can stand up to the challenge, this is it.

polishes.name: Sticky but Not Tacky Base Coat
polishes.description: This is a warm purple neon creme with an orange/pink shimmer. It’s warm, inviting, and great on every skin tone. It will lean pink with the first application and turn toward warm purple with more coats.

polishes.name: The Comfort of You (v2
polishes.description: This is a shimmery magnetic that starts as fall browns and reds and magnetizes into a bold green with a strong orange/red magnetic. You’ll primarily see golds, greens, and a hint of blue, but will also get glints of red. The base color is a green designed to be the base for this sparkly magnetic surprise.

polishes.name: The Ritual
polishes.description: This top coat creates a gel effect with no UV light required. We suggest a single coat for great coverage. Of course, if you like a thicker coat we won’t stop you.This top coat is also Solar Friendly! That’s right, no UV blockers here so layer it up with your solars for maximum results.

polishes.name: Thicker Than a Bowl of Oatmeal Top Coat
polishes.description: This vibrant yellow polish shines with a nice yellow shimmer that gives a soft glow in natural light. While a single coat will give a gentle wash of color, two to three coats will bring the full body tones of the color in this polish. Please try various applications to find your favorite way to express your imagination!

polishes.name: Tilting at Windmills
polishes.description: This is a pretty nifty Uno Mas original! If you have, hmmm, ample cuticles these might be for you. When I started painting my nails, I had a hard time keeping my cuticles clean and cleanup took for-ev-er. I tried a bunch of clips and randomly found these and it was love at first clip. These clips are firm enough to keep your cuticles pulled down without pain and will snap back into shape when you're done. They're also acetone resistant so feel free to drop them in an acetone bath when they get dirty. This set comes with 5 tip clips (random colors), a cute zipper bag, and a clip for your clips so you can clip your clips wherever you need them! Additional Info & Disclaimers Some of the zipper bags included with this set may have a small manufacturer tag that reads "He chooses" which is the brand name printed on the bag by the supplier. Orders packed on or after February 3 may include bags without this tag. We are working on sourcing new bags without the tags.

polishes.name: Tip Clips
polishes.description: This may look like poison but it’s totally not. At least we don’t think so… This is a dark green jelly with a pink/orange shimmer that turns gold in the sunlight. It’s almost opaque in 3 coats and layers deliciously with other jellies or on top of magnetic polishes.

polishes.name: Vinotinto Con Amor
polishes.description: This natural beauty is a metallic pink nail polish with small duochrome flakies that shift from pink to orange giving your nails a beautiful look you have ever laid your eyes on. For a fully opaque look it is recommended to apply 2 layers of polish. Use a glossy top coat to get extra sparkle effect. The Geodes collection of 6 nail polishes was inspired and designed to complement our Geodes Eyeshadow Palette.
